verdict.rationale: Penpot's own docs say developers can "inspect and integrate code" with CSS, HTML, SVG and JSON output, so a first-party inspect capability exists. The evidence covers only that single marketing line; nothing documents layer measurements, style or asset extraction, iOS/Android snippets, or access without an editor seat. Missing for 10: layer measurements, style and asset export details, iOS/Android code snippets, evidence that inspection works without an editor seat, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can inspect any layer and get measurements, styles, assets, and code snippets (CSS/iOS/Android) without an editor seat

citations.quote: Inspect and integrate code that actually matches design. Enjoy open standards like CSS, HTML, SVG and JSON as well as Penpot's open file format.
